name: vscode-llm-mobile-bridge
description: A privacy-first mobile view of local Claude Code and Codex sessions.
// extensionKind: The gateway reads whichever machine's ~/.claude and ~/.codex stores it runs next to, so it follows the workspace: a Remote-SSH window serves that server's sessions, a local window serves the PC's. Pair the phone with each machine you want to reach.

commands.title: LLM Mobile Bridge: Copy Pairing Payload
LLM Mobile Bridge: Disconnect All Devices
LLM Mobile Bridge: Open Session Transcript

llmMobileBridge.autoStart.description: Start the loopback gateway automatically in trusted workspaces.

llmMobileBridge.port.description: Loopback WebSocket port used by the development gateway.

llmMobileBridge.mobileUrl.description: URL copied to Android. The default reaches Windows localhost from an emulator. Local ws:// hosts (10.0.2.2, 127.0.0.1, localhost) get the active gateway port substituted; any other URL — e.g. a wss:// reverse-proxy domain — is copied exactly as configured.

llmMobileBridge.hostName.description: Name shown on the phone for this machine (e.g. "Домашний ПК", "prod-server"). Empty means the machine's hostname.

llmMobileBridge.relayUrl.description: Optional wss:// relay URL (e.g. wss://bridge.example.com). When set, the extension keeps an outbound connection to the relay and the pairing payload points the phone at this URL, so no inbound tunnel to the PC is needed.

llmMobileBridge.sessionScope.description: Show sessions from all projects or only from the current workspace folder.

llmMobileBridge.sessionLimit.description: Maximum number of sessions listed per provider.

llmMobileBridge.allowSendingMessages.description: Allow the mobile client to send new messages into existing Claude and Codex sessions.

llmMobileBridge.claudeExecutable.description: Path to the claude executable used for phone-initiated turns. Leave empty to auto-detect (CLAUDE_BIN, PATH, ~/.local/bin, the Claude Code VS Code extension).

llmMobileBridge.claudePermissionMode.description: Permission mode for Claude turns started from the phone. 'default' keeps project permission rules; tools without prior approval are denied.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test/json-rpc-client.test.js dist/test/session-registry.test.js dist/test/gateway-core.test.js dist/test/claude-adapter.test.js dist/test/codex-adapter.test.js dist/test/local-gateway-server.test.js dist/test/gateway-daemon-config.test.js dist/test/gateway-daemon.test.js dist/test/relay-server.test.js
scripts.probe: npm run build && node dist/index.js probe
scripts.gateway:serve: npm run build && node dist/gateway-daemon.js serve
scripts.gateway:pairing: npm run build && node dist/gateway-daemon.js pairing
scripts.gateway:token: npm run build && node dist/gateway-daemon.js token
scripts.package:vsix: npm run build && npm run bundle:extension && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('artifacts',{recursive:true})" && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out artifacts/llm-mobile-bridge.vsix
